_note: Startup JS = the entry script in dist/index.html plus everything it imports statically. Checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs in CI. Raise only with a reason in the PR.
_raised: 1200000 -> 1300000 bytes in the 2.0 early batch: thirteen features that each fit alone (agent status, zero-setup signals, attention inbox, model chips, plugin API v2, turn history, Review Desk, Land sheet, worktree recipes, Done-When, Feature Tracks, session host) land together and add about 80 KB of startup code and English strings. 1300000 -> 1310000 bytes in the 2.0 final fixes: the answered-notification tracking every terminal needs from the start (which key a person typed, the first output after it; about 2 KB), on top of the 2.0-X batch that left under 1 KB of room. 1310000 -> 1322000 bytes for the 2.0 launch contract (models, effort, accounts): measured on main with the UI kit, it adds 14400 bytes of startup JS (1306072 -> 1320472), mostly the English strings of Settings > Agents, the refused-launch banner and the requested model chip, which sit in the startup registry like every other English string, plus the session-event and chip code every terminal needs; the banner and Settings > Agents themselves load on demand. 1322000 -> 1330000 bytes for the 2.0 task launcher (⌘N rebuilt, presets, morning view): its English strings (about 7 KB: every chip, menu, option, fallback note and the morning view) sit in the startup registry like every other English string, and a terminal's check that an open dialog holds the keyboard is startup code; the launcher itself loads on demand. Measured 1328801 bytes with the launcher on top of the UI kit and the launch contract. 1330000 -> 1338000 bytes for the 2.0-R1 batch: the estimated cost everywhere with the Review Desk's Changes section, and exact status from Claude, Codex and Antigravity with the OS layer below them, add 5756 bytes of startup JS on top of the task launcher (1328801 -> 1334557), mostly their English strings in the startup registry plus the status folding every terminal needs from the start. 1338000 -> 1342000 bytes for the 2.0 UI chrome (UI-10..UI-14): the sidebar, pane header, status strip, status bar, activity bar and scope bar now draw with the control set, so its Button, Chip, Badge and ListRow must load at startup instead of with Settings and the UI kit screen (about 3.2 KB moved, not added), plus about 1.1 KB of chrome code; the chrome imports each control from its own module so the rest of the kit (menus, selects, tabs, fields, toggles) stays on demand. Measured 1334557 -> 1338889 bytes on top of the 2.0-R1 batch.
